gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants with WHO grade III recurrent malignant glioma will be allowed to enroll to Cohort 1 only.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Be at first or second relapse.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: CD8+ TIL Tumor Density-Cohort 2: CD8+ TIL density from tumors obtained from participants randomized to the neoadjuvant study arm (2A)

role_evidence.quote: This study is looking at the safety and efficacy of the drug combination of ASP8374 with cemiplimab in people with recurrent malignant glioma.
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has not approved ASP8374 as a treatment for any disease.
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has not approved cemiplimab for recurrent malignant glioma but it has been approved for other uses.

source_quote.quote: CD8+ TIL Tumor Density-Cohort 2: CD8+ TIL density from tumors obtained from participants randomized to the neoadjuvant study arm (2A)

coder_notes: Cohort 2 is randomised to neoadjuvant ASP8374 plus cemiplimab (2A) versus no checkpoint therapy before surgery (2B); all then receive the combination post-operatively. Registered arm labels are both EXPERIMENTAL; Group 2B acts as the control for the TIL endpoint. WHO grade III glioma allowed in Cohort 1 only. Tumour PK not planned; the pre-surgery tumour CD8+ TIL comparison is a pharmacodynamic endpoint.
